name.ja: HG 1/24 霊子戦闘機・試製桜武(天宮さくら機)
name.en: HG 1/24 Spirit Fighter Prototype Sakurabu (Amamiya Sakura Machine)

description.ja: 『新サクラ大戦』より、幻の機体「霊子戦闘機・試製桜武（天宮さくら機）」がHGにラインアップ！
description.en: From "New Sakura Wars ", the phantom aircraft " Spiritual Fighter Prototype Sakurabu (Sakura Amamiya Machine)" is added to the HG lineup!

description.ja: ■他の霊子戦闘機とは異なる構造・ギミックをプラモデルでも再現。
description.en: • The structure and gimmicks that are different from other Aiko fighters are also reproduced in the plastic model.

description.ja: ■特有の方法で開閉するコックピットハッチを再現。
description.en: • Reproduces the cockpit hatch that opens and closes in a unique way.

description.ja: ■羽根の展開ギミックを搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with a feather deployment gimmick.

description.ja: ■手足の関節部分に伸縮を可能とする延長ギミックを搭載。アクションポーズの幅が広がる。
description.en: • Equipped with an extension gimmick that allows the joints of the limbs to expand and contract. Expands the range of action poses.

description.ja: ■天宮さくらの搭乗時の姿を再現したフィギュアも付属。
description.en: • A figure that reproduces Sakura Amamiya's appearance when she is on board is also included.
